title: The Measuring Cup Not Washed
youtube_title: The Measuring Cup Not Washed | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honest words let a friend help with the repair.
summary: At a library table by the round window, Gita is tangled up with a measuring cup put away still sweet and almost hides it. Gita tells Miss Dalca the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
